done_when: The Node client tests keep npm's download cache between CI runs and give a cold download enough time, and the leftover-process scan skips files that disappear while it runs

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Test. The changed scan skips vanished directories and catches FileNotFoundError for markers, but no test makes a directory or marker disappear during cleanup. The existing process tests check for leftovers, so they would still pass if this race fix were removed. The named scan behavior has no regression test.
findings.title: Not done: the disappearing-file scan test

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Test. The Jest and Vitest close tests use the machine's normal npm cache. On a warm machine, they pass even if the command timeout reverts from 240 to 60 seconds. None of the changed tests checks the effective timeout or exercises a cold download, so the timeout part of the fix lacks a test that fails when it breaks.
findings.title: Not done: the cold Node download timeout test

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate. The proof list names the workflow cache assertion and Node close tests, but gives no named proof for the disappearing-file scan. It also claims “seven more” workflow tests without identifying them. Those entries cannot be checked against named proofs as required.
findings.title: Not done: proof list

why: Pull request test groups time out while npm downloads jest or vitest, and a leftover-process scan fails when a git folder vanishes mid-scan
